content.comment_body: Hello! We currently have a machine operating with a problematic control system. I'm considering replacing the control system with a [product_name]. The machine is used only once a year and remains disconnected from power most of the time. Is it possible for [product_name] to retain its program for a full year without power loss?
Yes, the program can be preserved for many years even if unpowered. However, the real-time clock battery typically lasts about 20 days.
The program in [product_name] is saved in flash memory, so even if the device loses power, the program remains intact.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are interested in the ability of [product_name] to retain its program when left without power for long periods. Responses confirm that [product_name] stores its program in non-volatile flash memory, ensuring indefinite retention without power. However, the real-time clock backup battery only lasts around 20 days, meaning clock-based features might not be reliable after prolonged power outages.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to keep its program intact even after extended periods without power, with no loss of data.
